title: The King's Hit List, Part 3
description: The King's Hit List, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 2 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Recruiter in Frump's Misfortune, collect the Proof of Pwnage, and remove any evidence of the identities of the slain assassins. Do all of that and then report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 4

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 2 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Recruiter in Frump's Misfortune, collect the Proof of Pwnage, and remove any evidence of the identities of the slain assassins. Do all of that and then report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Offer:

I've heard some rumblings about the Shadow's Embrace and the Guild of Shadows, but nothing that really reveals what is happening in the dungeon. I might be able to help you out, but you have got to do something for me first.

I don't really want to get into it, but I was sent here because the King's Board of Trustees said I was causing too much trouble in the field. The real reason is probably that I was too much of an assassinating machine, too efficient, and I was making everyone look bad. So, they stuck me here talking to brain dead newbies ever day. Let's just say it hasn't curbed my urge to kill...at all.

A couple days ago I took an assassination mission against the King's Board of Trustees wishes, but I promised them that I wouldn't accidently kill any friendlies this time. Well, all I can say is, things happen. If the King's Board of Trustees finds out that some of their assassins died by my hand during the mission, I'm done. I also need you to take out the target of the original mission , a Guild of Shadows Recruiter. The mission is actually on Level 2 of Frump's Misfortune, but I can give you access to a Guild of Shadows teleporter on Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace. Use it and it will take you where you need to go and bring you back when you are done. Report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate when you are done. I will find a way to send him word that might help your investigation. Good luck!

Turn-in:

If you had talked to Sir Prize he probably would have asked you to help him and in return he would have sent me some information about what is happening in the Shadow's Embrace.

Objectives:

  • Use Guild Teleporter on Level 2 ×1
  • Kill the Guild of Shadows Recruiter
  • Collect the Proof of Pwnage ×1
  • Remove any Evidence from Dead Assassins ×2

Client level range: 45–100
